title: Pencil with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g transform='rotate(-35 50 50)'>
    <!-- pencil body -->
    <rect x='38' y='20' width='24' height='55' rx='3' fill='#F5C542'/>
    <!-- lighter stripe on body -->
    <rect x='42' y='20' width='6' height='55' fill='#FFE08A'/>
    <!-- eraser end cap -->
    <rect x='38' y='15' width='24' height='10' rx='3' fill='#E87B9A'/>
    <rect x='38' y='22' width='24' height='4' fill='#C9C9D6'/>
    <!-- wood tip -->
    <polygon points='38,75 62,75 50,92' fill='#E8B97A'/>
    <!-- graphite tip -->
    <polygon points='45,84 55,84 50,92' fill='#8A6FD0'/>
    <!-- smiling face on body -->
    <circle cx='46' cy='45' r='2.6' fill='#3A3A5C'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='45' r='2.6' fill='#3A3A5C'/>
    <circle cx='46.8' cy='44.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <circle cx='54.8' cy='44.2' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
    <path d='M44 52 Q50 58 56 52' fill='none' stroke='#3A3A5C' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <circle cx='41' cy='51' r='2.2' fill='#F79EAF'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='51' r='2.2' fill='#F79EAF'/>
  </g>
</svg>
